{{Quote|Well, look, they don't call him Gouge for nothing, right?|Kal|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Gouge''' was the nickname of a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was incarcerated in [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Guard Lieutenant [[Brok (Belsavis)|Brok]] and three members of the disgraced [[Dagger Wing]]&mdash;[[Ty]], [[Symo]], and [[Lin (Dagger Wing)|Lin]]&mdash;located and captured Gouge, preventing him from escaping like other prisoners. They were pinned down until they were rescued by [[Havoc Squad]], which helped them evacuate the prisoner to a more secure location.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gouge appears in the Trooper class mission "Overwhelming Force" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]]. Players can [[Death/Legends|kill]] Gouge for dark side alignment points.<ref name="TOR" />
